working_title: Self-Evolution Should Not Depend on How Skills Are Split
problem_statement: Self-evolving skill systems use skill artifacts as control units for sampling, retrieval, feedback credit, refinement, and admission. If two taxonomies represent the same semantic capability/support set but differ only in how that set is split, cloned, or hierarchically overlapped across package identities, a representation-invariant evolution operator should not change its induced control distribution solely because the artifact parameterization changed.

narrow_principle.name: Skill-Taxonomy Representation Invariance (STRI)
narrow_principle.informal_definition: For a semantics-preserving taxonomy transformation phi that does not add a new executable capability or support region, the induced self-evolution control law should remain invariant, or any change must be explicitly justified by new evidence rather than package multiplicity.
objects: retrieval exposure under a fixed semantic budget
not_claimed: semantic skill redundancy is newly discovered
all overlapping skills should be merged
duplicate arms are a new online-learning phenomenon
Skill-SP or SkillRL overall performance is poor
current control-plane violations necessarily reduce end-task accuracy without a dynamic test

first_party_evidence.mechanism: package-wise adaptive skill sampling plus skill_id-level feedback/refinement credit
first_party_evidence.real_support_evidence: On all 530 bundled API-Bank level-1/3 rows, released validators cover 348; 183/348 covered rows (52.586%) have multiple skill memberships, all as specific+generic overlap across 5 distinct pairs and 14 answer tools.
first_party_evidence.released_taxonomy_result: Without adding any clone, median package-level eligibility exposure mass is 2.0x for multi-membership versus single-membership rows under the released sampler state.
first_party_evidence.dedup_result: The released name+description Jaccard duplicate filter at threshold 0.33 misses all 5/5 observed support-overlap pairs (pair similarities 0.1429-0.20).
first_party_evidence.exact_equivalence_result: An exact semantic ID split inflates the equivalence-class normalized sampler mass by 87.5% for all 15 released skills under the frozen reset-stat state.

first_party_evidence.mechanism: dynamic skill IDs receive retrieval priority in the official template-mode SkillBank; add_skills rejects only duplicate IDs
first_party_evidence.exact_equivalence_result: For each of 12 released general skills independently, an exact content clone with only a fresh dyn_NNN ID is accepted 12/12. Across 223 released ALFWorld task descriptions, all 2676 prompt comparisons change; 11/12 clone targets change the unique semantic retrieval set and 5/12 reduce the number of unique general-skill contents under fixed top_k=6.

reduction_matrix.established_object: multi-modal skill clone detection, including semantic clones, ecosystem-scale clone propagation, and deduplication analysis
reduction_matrix.directly_absorbs: Any novelty claim that semantic skill redundancy/cloning is common or that exact duplicate skills should be detected/deduplicated.
reduction_matrix.residual: STRI concerns how online self-evolution control changes under semantically equivalent or partially overlapping taxonomy representations; Skill-SP's decisive released overlap is hierarchical partial support overlap rather than exact clone identity.

reduction_matrix.established_object: lifecycle governance of redundant/environment-sensitive skills: recommendation before execution, skill-linked attribution after execution, evidence-gated updates
reduction_matrix.directly_absorbs: Generic claims that redundancy can harm exposure/credit or that lifecycle governance should combine recommendation, attribution, and evolution.
reduction_matrix.residual: A formal representation-invariance test asks whether two semantics-preserving taxonomies induce the same evolution operator. Low-redundancy recommendation and attribution need not guarantee invariance to split/merge/overlap reparameterization.

reduction_matrix.established_object: hierarchical SkillBank, adaptive retrieval, recursive skill evolution
reduction_matrix.directly_absorbs: Generic hierarchical skill-library and recursive-evolution method claims.
reduction_matrix.residual: Author implementation itself provides an independent violation witness: fresh dynamic identity changes fixed-budget retrieval despite exact content equivalence.

reduction_matrix.established_object: co-evolving proposer, solver, dynamic skill controller; tasks conditioned on dynamically sampled skills and execution feedback updates/expands the library
reduction_matrix.residual: Released controller supplies the first support-overlap witness: package multiplicity changes eligibility mass and identity is also the feedback/refinement unit.

reduction_matrix.established_object: online decisions with similarity structure over context-arm pairs and adaptive partitions that exploit that similarity
reduction_matrix.directly_absorbs: The generic idea that similar alternatives should share structure instead of being treated as unrelated categorical arms.
reduction_matrix.residual: STRI is not a fixed-arm regret problem: the skill identities/support regions are endogenously created, refined, and reused as both curriculum/retrieval actions and future credit/update state.

reduction_matrix.established_object: reward estimation for stochastic experts leveraging information leakage among experts
reduction_matrix.directly_absorbs: The generic idea that overlapping/similar experts provide cross-expert information and independent per-expert treatment wastes structure.
reduction_matrix.residual: Does not by itself define invariance of an evolving artifact library to semantics-preserving split/clone/merge operations, nor the coupled effect on artifact creation and future training distribution.

strongest_simple_reductions_to_test_next.evidence: 5/5 support-overlap pairs below the frozen 0.33 Jaccard threshold

strongest_simple_reductions_to_test_next.reason: R1b uses no synthetic clone; 183 real tasks are accepted by distinct specific and generic skills. Removing an exact clone does not resolve hierarchical partial support overlap.

strongest_simple_reductions_to_test_next.required_test: Instantiate a same-information overlap-aware control baseline on the frozen Skill-SP support matrix and determine whether it removes representation sensitivity without needing a new STRI-specific method.
Test whether low-redundancy selection alone makes control mass and credit invariant under partial hierarchical overlap; if yes, stop standalone STRI method claim.

reason_paper_design_still_blocked: Static/control-plane reduction is no longer the blocker: current-source review is SURVIVES_NARROWLY; the mandatory-overlap theorem plus decision-time reduction closes the frozen-state pre-context single-package controller class on the released Skill-SP graph; SQC theory/method/full blueprint are frozen.
